Name: (CP) Victorian Craftables
Author: Hadi42
TagLine: A set of basic craftables inspired by Eemie's Victorian Buildings, now featuring seasonal flowers.
Description:
I like having things match, so I made a set of basic craftables to go with [Eemie's victorian buildings](https://www.moddrop.com/stardew-valley/mods/580707-eemies-victorian-buildings-for-cp) (with permission from [Minervamaga](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/51777556) <3). These craftables use the same palette, so they should fit right in.

**(Note: this mod doesn't include any furniture/special craftables/1.6 items YET. Maybe never, but maybe someday. C'est la vie.)**

You can choose between seasonal or clean versions in the config, and individually toggle each craftable to be ignored. Winter craftables also come with the choice between red flowers or plain snow.

Many thanks to [Eemiestardew](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/34984615?tab=about+me) for all her lovely mods, which you can now find on [Moddrop](https://www.moddrop.com/stardew-valley/profile/99667/mods).

Thanks to LenneDalben for updating the seasonal version to work with the updated CP! (Truthfully she did this ages ago and I totally forgot to test and update it ;;)

To install, unzip and drop "[CP] Victorian Craftables" into your mod folder.

If you like my mods, please consider donating!

Downloads.Description: Delete old versions and unzip into your mods folder.
